raw.text: I initiate Zai Lab at Buy with a $43 target; the China franchise provides a floor, while Zoci's global potential is underappreciated. ZLAB's China business faces price cuts and ZEJULA competition, but sequential product revenue growth and management's 2027 growth outlook suggest stabilization. Zoci's early SCLC and epNEC data support a potential global oncology re-rating, with epNEC topline results and a possible U.S. BLA in 2027.

raw.text: Zai Lab looks underappreciated as the wholly owned developer of zoci, a potential DLL3 treatment backbone, rather than merely a China distributor. I estimate roughly ten quarters of debt-adjusted cash runway at elevated trial spending, while management expects product revenue growth to return in 2027.

recentNews.title: Celldex Reports Results from Phase 2 Study of Barzolvolimab in Atopic Dermatitis

raw.title: Celldex Reports Results from Phase 2 Study of Barzolvolimab in Atopic Dermatitis
raw.text: HAMPTON, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Celldex (NASDAQ:CLDX) today reported topline results from the Company's Phase 2 study of barzolvolimab in moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (AD). Barzolvolimab, a first-in-class humanized monoclonal antibody with a novel mechanism of action that uniquely targets the KIT receptor and depletes mast cells, is being studied across multiple indications where mast cells are implicated in the disease pathology. The primary endpoint of the Phase 2 AD study, the percent change from baseline in the weekly average of the daily Peak Pruritus Numerical Rating Scale (PP-NRS) score at Week 16 compared to placebo, and key secondary endpoints were not met. While some benefit from barzolvolimab treatment was observed, these improvements did not meet the Company's internal hurdle rate for continued development. Data suggest that while mast cells contribute to AD, they are not a primary driver of the disease. Based on these results, Celldex is discontinuing development in AD. Consistent with previously reported studies, barzolvolimab demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile.

raw.title: Kestra Announces Publication of ACE-PAS, the Largest Prospective Real-World Wearable Defibrillator Study, in the Journal of Cardiovascular Electrophysiology
raw.text: KIRKLAND, Wash., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kestra Medical Technologies, Ltd. (Nasdaq: KMTS), a leading wearable medical device and digital healthcare company, today announced publication of primary results from the ASSURE® WCD Clinical Evaluation Post-Approval Study (ACE-PAS) in the Journal of Cardiovascular Electrophysiology. The largest prospective real-world study of wearable cardioverter defibrillators (WCD) to date, ACE-PAS enrolled 21,612 patients across 35 U.S. states and met both primary safety and effectiveness endpoints. The study demonstrated 100% all-shock conversion success and sustained daily wear, while documenting ventricular arrhythmias early and continuously over subsequent months. raw.text: KIRKLAND, Wash., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kestra Medical Technologies, Ltd. (Nasdaq: KMTS), a leading wearable medical device and digital healthcare company, today announced publication of primary results from the ASSURE® WCD Clinical Evaluation Post-Approval Study (ACE-PAS) in the Journal of Cardiovascular Electrophysiology. The largest prospective real-world study of wearable cardioverter defibrillators (WCD) to date, ACE-PAS enrolled 21,612 patients across 35 U.S. states and met both primary safety and effectiveness endpoints. The study demonstrated 100% all-shock conversion success and sustained daily wear, while documenting ventricular arrhythmias early and continuously over subsequent months. The findings strengthen the clinical case for the ASSURE system across WCD indications and underscore the importance of protecting patients throughout periods of elevated arrhythmic risk.

raw.title: Pharvaris Presents Clinical and Real-World Data at the ACAAI 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting
raw.text: ZUG, Switzerland, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pharvaris (Nasdaq: PHVS), a late-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel, oral bradykinin B2 receptor antagonists to help address unmet needs of those living with bradykinin-mediated diseases such as hereditary angioedema (HAE) and acquired angioedema due to C1 inhibitor deficiency (AAE-C1INH), summarized the oral and poster presentations at the American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (ACAAI) 2026 Annual Scientific Meeting, taking place November 12-16, 2026, in Phoenix, Arizona. The presentations include late-breaking results from the Phase 3 CHAPTER-3 study evaluating investigational oral deucrictibant extended-release (XR) tablet for prophylaxis of HAE attacks to be presented in the Distinguished Industry and Late-breaking Oral Abstracts sessions on Saturday, November 14 from 4:30 – 6:00 p.m. MST, as well as final long-term results from the prophylaxis Phase 2 open-label extension, additional analyses of the pivotal Phase 3 on-demand treatment study, clinical pharmacology data supporting the potential combined use of the XR and immediate-release (IR) formulations, a comprehensive assessment of deucrictibant's cardiovascular safety across the development program, and the real-world economic burden of HAE.

The trouble is that a 10%+ yield often looks like a red flag, and many investors give up on high-yielders right before they prove their worth. The answer is to hold only income machines that can realistically keep paying through rate shocks, credit downturns, and sector-wide sell-offs.

raw.title: 2 BDCs To Own If SOFR Goes Higher
raw.text: A 50 bps hike would give BDC earnings a modest boost. The catch is that higher rates add pressure on already-stretched borrowers, and credit quality is quietly weakening. In this article, I elaborate on 2 BDCs that stand out for low leverage, fixed-rate funding, and well-cushioned portfolios.

raw.title: Capital Southwest: A Strong BDC, But Not A Buy
raw.text: Capital Southwest is rated Hold, offering an 11.0% distribution yield at a 1.40× NAV premium. Pre-tax NII covers the regular dividend, but GAAP NII covers only 87.5% of the total distribution, raising sustainability questions. Accretive share sales supported NAV, yet diluted NII per share; credit quality is drifting, and leverage is rising.

raw.title: 11%+ Yields That Are Not Yield Traps
raw.text: Dividend yields above 11% typically signal significant risks, but occasionally the market offers opportunities to collect exceptionally high income without taking on excessive risk. Strong balance sheets, conservative underlying asset structuring, and proven track records can help protect double-digit dividend payouts. I discuss two compelling income opportunities offering approximately 11% to 12% yields, explain their dividend coverage and risks, and assess why they could deliver attractive long-term total returns.

raw.text: NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: SLS) (“SELLAS” or the “Company”), a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel therapies for a broad range of cancer indications, today announced the pricing of its previously announced underwritten public offering of 11,538,462 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $13.00 per share. raw.title: Immuneering Presents Additional Data Demonstrating Atebimetinib's Broad Potential as a Backbone for Combination Therapy in Pancreatic Cancer
raw.text: - Atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapies has shown excellent results in Phase 2, including long survival and an outstanding tolerability profile in an all-comers population of first-line pancreatic cancer patients treated with atebimetinib + mGnP, as presented in June at ASCO - - Atebimetinib in combination with CLDN18.2-targeted agents will be evaluated in two clinical trials in recently announced collaboration with Astellas - - Atebimetinib in combination with PRMT5 inhibitors, KRAS G12V inhibitors, and KRAS G12D inhibitors demonstrated synergistic activity in preclinical data presented at the 2026 EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium - - Atebimetinb in combination with chemotherapy is currently being evaluated in Phase 3 MAPKeeper 301 trial in an all-comers population of first-line pancreatic cancer patients - NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today presented new preclinical data demonstrating the potential of atebimetinib to serve as a backbone for combinations with multiple classes of anticancer agents. The findings, generated using both animal models and three-dimensional (3D) tumor models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), identify multiple synergistic combination strategies and provide further support for atebimetinib's potential to play a central role as a MAPK pathway backbone for combinations in pancreatic cancer and beyond.

raw.title: Immuneering Presents Data That Supports Expanding the Clinical Evaluation of Atebimetinib to Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer
raw.text: - Atebimetinib has already reported compelling Phase 2 clinical data in first-line pancreatic cancer, is currently being evaluated in a Phase 3 trial in first-line pancreatic cancer, and will soon begin a Phase 2 trial in first-line RAS-mutant lung cancer - - Atebimetinib demonstrated anti-tumor activity across all nine anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) cell lines evaluated, including BRAF V600E-mutant, RAS-mutant and MAPK-unaltered, in data presented at the 2026 EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium - - Atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapy demonstrated better tumor control than either chemotherapy alone or dabrafenib + trametinib in an animal model of BRAF V600E-mutant ATC, supporting planned Phase 2 trial in second-line ATC patients - NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today announced compelling preclinical data that supports expanding the clinical development of atebimetinib, its investigational deep cyclic MEK inhibitor, to a third tumor type: anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC). The findings were presented at the 38th EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics in Barcelona, Spain.

raw.title: Immuneering Announces New Potentially Registrational Phase 2 Trial Evaluating Atebimetinib with Chemotherapy in Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer
raw.text: - Company plans to evaluate atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapy in a Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC), a highly aggressive cancer with significant unmet need commonly driven by BRAF or RAS mutations - - IND submission planned by year-end 2026, with first patient dosing targeted for mid-2027; study is designed to be potentially registrational - - Preclinical data supporting the rationale for atebimetinib + chemotherapy in ATC to be presented at the 38th EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium on November 18, 2026 – - Aligns with Immuneering's strategy to provide a broad population of cancer patients with important new treatment options – - Company to hold investor webcast today at 8:30am EST, to discuss both of today's news announcements; including its clinical development plans in anaplastic thyroid cancer and the collaboration to evaluate CLDN18.2 programs in combination with atebimetinib for pancreatic cancer - NEW YORK, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today announced plans to initiate a Phase 2 clinical trial evaluating atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapy in patients with anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC), a highly aggressive form of thyroid cancer with significant unmet need, commonly driven by BRAF or RAS mutations. raw.text: LONDON, Ontario, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aduro Clean Technologies Inc.  (“Aduro” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: ADUR) (TSX: ACT) (FSE: 9D5), a clean technology company using the power of chemistry to transform lower-value feedstocks, like waste plastics, heavy bitumen, and renewable oils, into resources for the 21st century, today announced that it has engaged Delphi, a Canadian sustainability consultancy, to advance the next phase of its Life Cycle Assessment (“LCA”) program for Hydrochemolytic™ Technology (“HCT”). raw.title: El Pollo Loco: Store Opening Pace To Accelerate In 2027
raw.text: We reiterate our "Buy" on El Pollo Loco despite a roughly 40% year-to-date rally; shares trade at approximately 6x estimated FY27 EBITDA. LOCO's differentiated flame-grilled chicken offering supports peer-beating comps; Q3 systemwide sales rose 5%, with pricing gains accompanied by positive traffic. We see upside to FY27 growth expectations as LOCO targets 25–30 openings, up from roughly 20 in FY26, through largely franchise-led expansion.

raw.title: El Pollo Loco: Still Cooking, Despite The Hangover
raw.text: El Pollo Loco remains a Buy, targeting a ~$20 price range on a return to ~10x EBITDA, despite recent margin pressures. Same-store sales accelerated to 5% year-over-year with slightly positive traffic, but restaurant-level margins plateaued at 18.4%, raising concerns about future profitability. LOCO's asset-light turnaround is intact, with 18–20 openings projected for FY 2026 and 25–30 in FY 2027, over 80% franchise-driven, supporting a potential re-rating.

raw.text: DENVER, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pure Cycle Corporation (NASDAQ Capital Market: PCYO) (“Pure Cycle”, the “Company”, “we”, “us” or “our”) announced its financial results for the year ended August 31, 2026. Total revenue for the year ended August 31, 2026 grew 37% to a record $35.7 million, with growth in each of our three business segments. Lot sales revenue increased 45% on accelerated development activity at Sky Ranch, water and wastewater segment revenue increased 30% on higher water sales to oil and gas operators, and single-family rental revenue increased 73% as we placed 36 additional rental homes in service. Operating income increased 75% to $13.4 million, which more than offset a $4.7 million decrease in oil and gas royalty income. Pure Cycle reported $14.2 million of net income, or $0.59 per fully diluted common share, each a 9% increase from 2025, marking our ninth consecutive profitable fiscal year and twenty-ninth consecutive fiscal quarter with positive net income. Our diversified water and land platform was on full display this year, as steady, annual-cadence lot deliveries to our national homebuilder partners were complemented by a sharp increase in water sales to oil and gas operators.

raw.text: Designation covers onvansertib in combination with FOLFIRI/bevacizumab for adult patients with KRAS- or NRAS-mutated mCRC The designation is supported by clinical data from the ongoing randomized, controlled CRDF-004 clinical trial SAN DIEGO, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cardiff Oncology, Inc. raw.text: November 18, 2026, ST. PETERSBURG, FL – Water Tower Research (www.watertowerresearch.com) will host its inaugural WTR Forum Series event, “CLEAN AIR AND WATER: Feedstock, Filtration, and PFAS Solutions,” on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 9:00 am ET. Companies invited include Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ), BP Polymers (private), Clinch Resources Ltd. (TSX: CLCH), and Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT). The WTR Forum Series convenes companies, senior management, and expert speakers around a theme that matters to investors. This event follows the clean air and water value chain, from specialty carbon feedstocks, to the activated carbon that removes PFAS and mercury from water and captures fuel vapor in vehicles, to packaging that prevents PFAS at the source. (Nasdaq: IRD) (“Opus Genetics” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing gene therapies to restore vision and prevent blindness in patients with inherited retinal diseases (IRDs), today announced that the first participant has been dosed in its Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating OPGx-RDH12, an investigational gene therapy for RDH12-associated Leber congenital amaurosis (RDH12-LCA), a rare inherited retinal disease that causes progressive vision loss and blindness beginning in early childhood and affects approximately 2,500 individuals in the U.S. The milestone follows U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance of the Company's Investigational New Drug (IND) application in October 2026 and marks the advancement of Opus Genetics' third gene therapy program into clinical development.

raw.title: Vivani Medical Announces Positive Top-Line Results from SLIM-1™, a First in Human Phase 1 Trial of NPM-139 (semaglutide implant) and Wegovy (weekly semaglutide injections) in Obese and Overweight Subjects
raw.text: Strong NPM-139 safety and tolerability profile: -0 of 10 NPM-139 subjects experienced adverse events reported as treatment related -5 of 10 Wegovy subjects (control group) experienced adverse events reported as treatment related (gastrointestinal only, consistent with marketed GLP-1 therapies) Encouraging NPM-139 semaglutide release profile: -No NPM-139 rapid drug exposure increases; maximum drug levels from a single administration measured at ~16 days (versus ~2.4 days for the Wegovy control group) -NPM-139 semaglutide delivery was encouraging and consistent with preclinical performance -Comparable weight loss was observed between the NPM-139 and Wegovy groups Clinical advancement supported: -Vivani will advance NPM-139 towards a Phase 2 dose-ranging weight maintenance trial anticipated to begin in 2027 -Vivani will explore the potential for clinical development of NPM-139 in GLP-1-naïve patients based on the positive SLIM-1 tolerability profile ALAMEDA, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vivani Medical, Inc. (Nasdaq: VANI) (“Vivani” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing miniature, ultra-long-acting drug implants utilizing its proprietary NanoPortal™ technology, today reported positive top-line results from SLIM-1, the Company's recently completed Phase 1 trial of low-dose NPM-139 (semaglutide implant) and a control group of low-dose Wegovy™ (semaglutide injection).

raw.text: TORONTO, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Electra Battery Materials Corporation (NASDAQ: ELBM; TSX-V: ELBM) (“Electra” or the “Company”) today announced that its senior leadership will connect with investors, government and industry partners at several key industry events over the coming weeks, as construction of its North American battery-grade cobalt sulfate refinery continues. At each event, Electra will provide market updates on the refinery construction and outline its vision for an allied refining supply chain – one that reduces reliance on concentrated foreign supply. That vision starts with the cobalt refinery and extends to nickel refining and battery recycling, building a multi-metal refining platform for North America and its allies.

("Gamehaus" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: GMHS) today announced that its AI-driven game production pipeline has optimized the efficiency for building a playable game prototype: from roughly three developers working one to one-and-a-half weeks under the Company's traditional process, to an average of one developer working one-and-a-half to two days. raw.text: Global CRO Brings Extensive Oncology Experience, Including Breast Cancer and Early-Phase Clinical Development Executed Clinical Trial Agreements Support Targeted Clinical Initiation in the First Quarter of 2027 MIAMI, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Telomir Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: TELO) (“Telomir” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing small-molecule therapeutics targeting epigenetic and metabolic pathways implicated in cancer, today announced that it has selected Linical, a global contract research organization (CRO) with extensive oncology experience, to support its FDA-cleared Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating Telomir-Zn in patients with advanced or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). Telomir has executed a Master Services Agreement and clinical trial Work Order with Linical, establishing the operational framework to advance the study toward clinical initiation, targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

raw.text: HANGZHOU, China, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Greenland Technologies Holding Corporation (Nasdaq: GTEC) ("Greenland" or the "Company"), a technology developer and manufacturer of electric industrial vehicles and drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and vehicles, today announced that the Company received a written notification (the "Notification Letter") from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") on November 10, 2026, notifying the Company that it is not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement set forth in the Nasdaq Listing Rules for continued listing on the Nasdaq. Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) requires listed securities to maintain a minimum bid price of US$1.00 per share, and Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A) provides that a failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement exists if the deficiency continues for a period of 30 consecutive business days.

raw.title: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. Announces Closing of $12.75 Million Senior Secured Convertible Notes Offering
raw.text: BEIJING, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. (“Autozi” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: AZI), one of the leading and fast-growing lifecycle automotive service providers in China, today announced that, on November 17, 2026, it entered into a definitive Securities Purchase Agreement (the “Agreement”) with the investors identified in the schedule of buyers thereto (collectively, the “Investors”) and completed the initial closing of the transactions contemplated by the Agreement (the “Initial Closing”), at which the Company issued and sold senior secured convertible notes in an aggregate original principal amount of $12.75 million (the “Initial Notes”) in a registered direct offering. The Agreement also provides for the potential issuance of up to $17.25 million in aggregate original principal amount of additional notes, subject to mutual agreement and the applicable closing conditions, bringing the maximum aggregate original principal amount contemplated by the Agreement to $30 million. Of the $12.24 million aggregate purchase price for the Initial Notes, approximately $2.85 million was satisfied by cancellation of the Company's outstanding advance promissory note held by the lead investor, $1.65 million, less transaction expenses withheld by the lead investor, was paid to the Company in cash at the Initial Closing and the remaining approximately $7.74 million was deposited into a control account and will be released to the Company only upon satisfaction of the conditions specified in the Notes. The Company intends to use the cash proceeds for working capital, subject to the restrictions on the release and use of proceeds in the Notes.

raw.title: Traws Pharma Reports Final Phase 2a Results for Ratutrelvir in COVID-infected Subjects, Showing Fewer Treatment-Related Adverse Events and No Viral Rebounds Versus PAXLOVID®
raw.text: Ratutrelvir , a once-daily, ritonavir-free oral antiviral therapy in development for COVID-19 infections, showed symptom resolution time comparable to PAXLOVID ® , with no viral rebound through Day 28 and fewer treatment-related adverse events in subjects eligible to receive PAXLOVID ® Similar results were obtained in PAXLOVID ® -ineligible subjects, a population with limited oral treatment options, with no treatment-related adverse events Traws intends to discuss with the FDA a registration path focused on PAXLOVID ® -ineligible patients Tivoxavir marboxil (TXM)'s bridging study of a compressed tablet formulation achieved its objectives, supporting the potential for TXM's once-monthly dosing regimen and use in further efficacy studies. TXM is an investigational long-acting prophylactic agent for seasonal and pandemic influenza TXM toxicology retesting completed, with two independent rat Pig-a gene mutation studies showing no mutagenic effect at doses up to 500 mg/kg and an improved margin compared with the original assay; regulatory resubmission planned for the fourth quarter of 2026 NEWTOWN, Pa.

raw.title: Renforth Completes Updated Mineral Resource Estimate On Wholly Owned Parbec Gold Deposit In Malartic, Quebec
raw.text: TORONTO, Ontario — November 18, 2026 – TheNewswire —  Renforth Resources Inc. (CSE: RFR | OTC: RFHRF | FSE: 9RR) ("Renforth" or the "Company") is pleased to advise shareholders that P&E Mining Consultants Inc. (“P&E”) have completed an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) on the Company's wholly owned Parbec Gold Deposit in Malartic, Quebec, located on the Cadillac Break and contiguous to Agnico Eagle's Canadian Malartic Mine Property.  The updated MRE, stated below, is comprised of a pit constrained, Indicated Mineral Resource of 168,700 ounces of gold grading 1.10 g/t contained within 4.77 million tonnes and an additional pit constrained Inferred Mineral Resource of 192,900 ounces of gold grading 1.22 g/t Au contained within 4.91 million tonnes. There is also an out of pit (underground) Inferred Mineral Resource of 74,200 ounces of gold, grading 1.79 g/t Au contained within 1.29 million tonnes. The total Mineral Resource presented by P&E, effective November 17, 2026, is 168,700 Indicated ounces of gold and 267,000 Inferred ounces of gold with the assumptions and considerations stated below. This represents an overall increase to the prior April 2025 MRE for Parbec, however, it does not trigger the requirement to file another Technical Report. As previously announced on Nov. 12, 2026, Renforth has retained P&E to commence overseeing metallurgical testwork on Parbec mineralization which is designed to support a Preliminary Economic Assessment in 2027.   “I am pleased to deliver this Mineral Resource increase, for our Parbec Gold Deposit to shareholders at this time, however, at the same time I want to emphasize that our work at Parbec is ongoing. We are awaiting results from the additional channels cut within the open pit footprint announced last week and will be working to establish the metallurgical characteristics of the Deposit. Additionally, we are permitted for a significant amount of drilling in the next two years. Today's announcement makes our Mineral Resource current, in terms of gold price and the inclusion of all our completed exploration work. We will continue to move forward from here” states Nicole Brewster, President and CEO of Renforth.

raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SNOWLINE GOLD CORP. (TSX: SGD) (US OTCQB: SNWGF) (the “Company” or “Snowline”) is pleased to announce additional drill results from its 2026 exploration program, including discovery of widespread gold mineralization at its Duke target, a reduced-intrusion related gold system (“RIRGS”) located 12 km southeast of the Company's flagship Valley gold deposit on its 100% owned Rogue Project (Figure 5). Drillhole DUK-26-004 intersected 1.03 g/t Au over 65.8 m, including a 1.0 m interval at 32.20 g/t Au (Table 1), while DUK-26-005, collared 675 m to the northeast, intersected 9.0 m averaging 1.12 g/t Au within a broader zone of mineralization (Table 2). At Valley, infill hole V-26-165 returned 450.2 m averaging 1.47 g/t Au from surface, including 210.5 m at 2.07 g/t Au, outperforming the Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) block model. The hole ended with an additional 44.3 m intersection averaging 0.72 g/t Au (Table 2) in an otherwise untested area at depth to the northeast of the main deposit (Figure 7).

raw.text: U.S. equity markets rebounded despite a surge in Treasury yields, as hotter-than-expected inflation disrupted the recent bond rally and sharply increased expectations for additional Fed tightening. raw.title: Hot Inflation Grounds Bond Rally
raw.text: U.S. equity markets rebounded despite a surge in Treasury yields, as hotter-than-expected inflation disrupted the recent bond rally and sharply increased expectations for additional Fed tightening. Consumer and producer inflation remained uncomfortably firm, reinforcing concerns that the recent energy shock is increasingly bleeding into core prices, services, and other broader inflation categories. The S&P 500 snapped a four-week losing streak with a 2.6% gain, while the Nasdaq 100 rebounded 3.7% despite Nvidia plunging roughly 13% following Jensen Huang's resignation.

raw.title: Losers Of REIT Earnings Season
raw.text: Strong Season, Bigger Dispersion: REIT earnings were broadly excellent, but this quarter produced a much sharper winners-and-losers dynamic, with three REITs plunging more than 40% and another dozen dipping 15%+. Mortgage Stress Reaccelerated: Commercial mREITs saw renewed delinquencies - increasingly in multifamily - while Residential mREITs absorbed sizable mark-to-market losses as the late-summer surge in rates and wider mortgage spreads. Dividend Cuts Made A Comeback: Four mortgage REITs reduced or suspended dividends during earnings season - the most cuts since the pandemic - while several additional payouts remain under review.

raw.text: November 18, 2026, ST. PETERSBURG, FL – Water Tower Research (www.watertowerresearch.com) will host its inaugural WTR Forum Series event, “CLEAN AIR AND WATER: Feedstock, Filtration, and PFAS Solutions,” on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 9:00 am ET. Companies invited include Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ), BP Polymers (private), Clinch Resources Ltd. (TSX: CLCH), and Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT). The virtual event offers investors direct access to senior management through executive fireside chats, company management presentations, and curated one-on-one meetings. Registration is open here. The WTR Forum Series convenes companies, senior management, and expert speakers around a theme that matters to investors. This event follows the clean air and water value chain, from specialty carbon feedstocks, to the activated carbon that removes PFAS and mercury from water and captures fuel vapor in vehicles, to packaging that prevents PFAS at the source. Sessions will cover regulation as a demand driver, feedstock security and critical minerals designations, activated carbon supply and pricing, capital-light PFAS treatment, clean air through the hybrid vehicle transition, barrier alternatives to fluorinated plastic containers, and what to watch into 2027.

raw.text: November 18, 2026, ST. PETERSBURG, FL – Water Tower Research (www.watertowerresearch.com) will host its inaugural WTR Forum Series event, “CLEAN AIR AND WATER: Feedstock, Filtration, and PFAS Solutions,” on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 9:00 am ET. Companies invited include Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ), BP Polymers (private), Clinch Resources Ltd. (TSX: CLCH), and Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT). The virtual event offers investors direct access to senior management through executive fireside chats, company management presentations, and curated one-on-one meetings. Registration is open here. The WTR Forum Series convenes companies, senior management, and expert speakers around a theme that matters to investors. This event follows the clean air and water value chain, from specialty carbon feedstocks, to the activated carbon that removes PFAS and mercury from water and captures fuel vapor in vehicles, to packaging that prevents PFAS at the source. Sessions will cover regulation as a demand driver, feedstock security and critical minerals designations, activated carbon supply and pricing, capital-light PFAS treatment, clean air through the hybrid vehicle transition, barrier alternatives to fluorinated plastic containers, and what to watch into 2027.

PETERSBURG, FL – Water Tower Research (www.watertowerresearch.com) has published an Initiation of Coverage Report on Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT) titled, “High-Margin Carbon Franchise Riding a Structural Shift to Hybrids with PFAS Upside”. The report can be accessed here. Ingevity is a global specialty materials company whose hardwood-based activated carbon captures gasoline vapor emissions in internal combustion and hybrid vehicles, and whose Evotherm warm mix asphalt additives help road builders pave at lower temperatures and extend road life. Ingevity offers investors a regulation-backed carbon franchise earning segment EBITDA margins above 50%, along with growth increasingly anchored in the structural shift toward hybrid vehicles, PFAS removal from municipal drinking water, and warm mix asphalt adoption.

raw.title: Selkirk Copper Completes Phase 2 Drill Program Comprising 54,579 Metres in 223 Drill Holes and Reports Additional High-Grade Results from Four Mineralized Zones
raw.text: Highlights Selkirk Copper has completed a two-phase drill program comprising 106,879 metres in 424 holes. Results of the Phase 1 drill program comprising 52,300 metres were used to support the 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate and Preliminary Economic Assessment Results from the Phase 2 drill program comprising 54,579 metres have not yet been incorporated into any economic study and will inform an updated mineral resource estimate that is planned to be completed in March 2027 Drilling was completed continuously over a span of 14 months, except for brief weather breaks, and ranks amongst the largest single-year drill programs ever completed in Yukon history Infill Drilling at Minto North continues to delineate high-grade copper and gold mineralization: 2.45% Cu, 4.36 g/t Au, and 11.1 g/t Ag (5.97% CuEq) over 4.9 m, within a broader interval of 2.45% CuEq over 19.5 m in drill hole 26SCM241 Within drill hole 26SCM241, individual sample intervals contain up to 35.2 g/t Au over 0.44 metres Step-out drilling at Area 118 intersects mineralization beyond the extents of previous resource estimation in this location: 2.68% Cu, 0.88 g/t Au, and 13.5 g/t Ag (3.28% CuEq) over 5.2 m, in drill hole 26SCM248, representing a 75-metre step-out from previous drilling in this area Infill drilling at Minto Main confirms continuity of high-grade mineralization: 3.44% Cu, 1.80 g/t Au, and 25.5 g/t Ag (4.86% CuEq) over 3.3 m, within a broader interval of 1.84 % CuEq over 10.2 metres in drill hole 26SCM240 Infill drilling at Copper Keel intersects high grades within a broader mineralized interval: 1.52% Cu, 0.61 g/t Au, and 3.5 g/t Ag (1.91% CuEq) over 9.0 m, within a broader interval of 0.83% CuEq over 53.0 metres in drill hole 26SCM254 Vancouver, British Columbia and Pelly Crossing, Yukon--(Newsfile Corp. - November 16, 2026) - Selkirk Copper Mines Inc. (TSXV: SCMI) (FSE: IO20) (OTCQX: SKRKF) ("Selkirk Copper" or the "Company") is pleased to announce completion of the Phase 2 drill program, as well as additional assay results from this program, which commenced in May 2026, at the Minto Project in Yukon, Canada.

raw.title: Yiren Digital Receives NYSE Notification Regarding Stock Price Requirement
raw.text: BEIJING, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Yiren Digital Ltd. (NYSE: YRD) ("Yiren Digital" or the "Company"), a leading company specializing in financial technology and artificial intelligence innovation across multiple industries in China and global markets, today announced that it received a letter dated October 20, 2026, from the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") notifying the Company that it was not in compliance with the NYSE's continued listing standard under Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual (the "Price Criteria") for the average closing price of the Company's American depositary shares (the "ADSs") was below US$1.00 per ADS over a consecutive 30-trading-day period.

The gross proceeds from the Offering will be used to incur eligible Canadian exploration expenses that qualify as "flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures" under the Income Tax Act (Canada), principally in connection with the advancement of Avalon's Nechalacho Rare Earths and Zirconium Project in the Northwest Territories, subject to applicable tax requirements.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Silver Elephant Mining Corp. (TSX: ELEF) (OTCQB: SILEF) (FSE: 1P2) ("Silver Elephant" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it is preparing to submit the Environmental Impact Assessment Study for a proposed 12,000 tonne-per-day ("tpd") mineral processing plant at its Pulacayo-Paca silver mining project ("Pulacayo-Paca"), in the Potosí Department of Bolivia (the "Plant"), by the end of December 2026. raw.title: Snowline Expands New Gold System at Its Duke Target, Intersecting 1.03 Grams Per Tonne Gold Over 65.8 M, and Reports 1.47 Grams Per Tonne Gold Over 450.2 M from Surface at Valley
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SNOWLINE GOLD CORP. (TSX: SGD) (US OTCQB: SNWGF) (the “Company” or “Snowline”) is pleased to announce additional drill results from its 2026 exploration program, including discovery of widespread gold mineralization at its Duke target, a reduced-intrusion related gold system (“RIRGS”) located 12 km southeast of the Company's flagship Valley gold deposit on its 100% owned Rogue Project (Figure 5). Drillhole DUK-26-004 intersected 1.03 g/t Au over 65.8 m, including a 1.0 m interval at 32.20 g/t Au (Table 1), while DUK-26-005, collared 675 m to the northeast, intersected 9.0 m averaging 1.12 g/t Au within a broader zone of mineralization (Table 2). At Valley, infill hole V-26-165 returned 450.2 m averaging 1.47 g/t Au from surface, including 210.5 m at 2.07 g/t Au, outperforming the Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) block model. The hole ended with an additional 44.3 m intersection averaging 0.72 g/t Au (Table 2) in an otherwise untested area at depth to the northeast of the main deposit (Figure 7).

raw.title: Viscount Identifies Three Near-Surface Gold-Copper Porphyry Targets at Passiflora Above 843.9-Metre Mineralized Intercept; Rosor High-Resolution Drone Survey Confirms District-Scale System

raw.text: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - November 1 9, 2026 - Ventripoint Diagnostics Ltd. (" Ventripoint " or the " Company "), (TSXV:VPT; OTC:VPTDF) is pleased to announce the sale of two VMS+™ cardiac imaging systems, which will be donated in honor of Ella's Umbrella. The systems will support clinical research and the integration of advanced cardiac imaging into routine patient care. One placement is planned to support a study involving pregnant women with congenital heart disease (CHD). Advances in the diagnosis and treatment of congenital heart conditions, together with improvements in surgical and interventional procedures, have enabled more patients with CHD to survive and live longer lives. As this population ages, patients increasingly encounter life events and medical conditions, including pregnancy, that can place additional demands on the heart. These circumstances create a growing need for accessible, accurate and comprehensive cardiac assessment to support clinical decision-making and patient management.

raw.title: Rocket Doctor and a Leading Canadian Pharmacy Chain Launch Digital Healthcare Pilot Across 25 Canadian Pharmacy Locations
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rocket Doctor AI Inc. ( CSE: AIDR , OTC: AIRDF , Frankfurt: 939 ) (“Rocket Doctor AI” or the “Company”) today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Rocket Doctor Inc. (“Rocket Doctor”), has launched an initial 90-day pilot program with a leading Canadian pharmacy chain to expand access to physician-led digital care through 25 participating pharmacy locations across Canada, beginning in Alberta, British Columbia and Ontario. The 90-day pilot program offers pharmacy customers a streamlined pathway to easily connect with Canadian medical professionals via Rocket Doctor's digital health platform. By providing participating pharmacies access to its software, patient care coordinators, and AI technology, Rocket Doctor simplifies patient navigation for comprehensive primary and urgent care services. “Community pharmacies are among the most accessible anchors of Canada's healthcare system, deeply embedded across even our most rural and remote regions. Partnering with them creates a natural bridge to connect patients with physicians right where they are, when they need care most,” said Dr. William Cherniak, Co-Founder and CEO of Rocket Doctor Inc. “By pairing a nationwide pharmacy network with Rocket Doctor's digital platform, we offer a seamless pathway that supports and elevates community pharmacists, including those operating under an expanded scope who wish to collaborate with physicians in a truly integrated, team-based care model.” As part of the initiative, Rocket Doctor may also provide select pharmacies with bluetooth-enabled smart medical devices, including digital stethoscopes, blood pressure cuffs, digital otoscopes, thermometers and pulse oximeters to support virtual consultations. The partnership is designed to complement the role of community pharmacies while preserving patient choice and professional judgment. Where prescriptions are appropriate following a consultation with a physician on Rocket Doctor, patients will have the opportunity to have their prescriptions filled through their preferred pharmacy. Launched in October 2026, the pilot program will initially run for 90 days. Following this period, the pharmacy chain will evaluate participating locations based on key performance metrics, including utilization, engagement, commercial results and other agreed performance criteria, to determine whether to expand the program across potentially hundreds of additional locations for a full one-year term. This initiative reflects Rocket Doctor's strategy to combine in-person and virtual care by partnering with established healthcare organizations across North America to expand access to physician-led services. Integrating digital health technology with trusted community locations helps patients, particularly in remote and underserved areas, connect with medical professionals. The platform also equips physicians with the tools and infrastructure required for efficient delivery of care, including ordering labs and imaging, writing specialist referrals, and scheduling follow-up appointments to ensure comprehensive, longitudinal care.

raw.title: Angkor Resources Hosts Government And NGO Delegation On Field Inspections
raw.text: GRANDE PRAIRIE, ALBERTA (November 12, 2026) – TheNewswire - ANGKOR RESOURCES CORP. (TSXV: ANK OTCQB: ANKOF) (“ANGKOR” OR “THE COMPANY”) announces that Angkor was pleased to host a joint delegation to showcase its integral community work in the field.  Taking advantage of a long-standing invitation, non-governmental organizations and the Royal Government of Cambodia attended field inspections at the company's working field sites.  The Ministry of Environment, the Ministry of Mines and Energy (“MME”), Development and Partnership in Action (“DPA”) and members of the Indigenous communities collectively discussed practices in field operations.   Angkor's team led more than twenty participants — government officials, non-government organization (“NGO”) representatives, local authorities and community members — into the field to see conditions first-hand and hear directly from the Indigenous communities. The visit is the latest step in Angkor's Environmental, Social and Governance (“ESG”) platform, which puts Indigenous rights and community wellbeing at the center of how the Company operates.

raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Prefeasibility Study outcome: after tax NPV of approximately US$1.3B at an 8% real discount rate and after-tax IRR of 24% for Cowboy State Mine, with pre-production capital of US$840M including contingency Value upside under way: recovery optimisation with Novex has commenced, and each one percentage point increase in NdPr recovery adds approximately US$50 million to NPV⁸ Greater definition and confidence: capital and operating costs estimated to ±25% accuracy, with contingency of 15% of direct capital compared with the 2026 Scoping Study accuracy of ±30-50% with contingency of 30% Long life domestic supply: mining and processing of 4.5 million tonnes per annum over 26 years, with average annual NdPr oxide production of approximately 2,500 tonnes, scheduled entirely from Probable Ore Reserves Maiden Ore Reserve: Probable Ore Reserve of 116.4 million tonnes at 1,257 ppm payable rare earth oxide (PREO) declared at Cowboy State Mine Feasibility Study advancing: drilling to convert Mineral Resources to Ore Reserves for the Feasibility Study is complete, with yttrium being assessed as a future product opportunity DENVER, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- American Rare Earths Limited (ASX: ARR | OTCQX: ARRNF | ADR: AMRRY) (“ARR” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce the results of the Prefeasibility Study (“PFS”) for Cowboy State Mine (“CSM”), the first development phase of the Halleck Creek Project in Wyoming, together with the declaration of a maiden Probable Ore Reserve. The PFS evaluates a 4.5 million tonne per annum open pit operation over 26 years, with estimated after tax NPV of approximately US$1.3B at an 8% real discount rate and pre-production capital of approximately US$840M, including contingency.

raw.title: Asante Reports Strong Open Pit Extension Potential at Bibiani Main Pit
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Asante Gold Corporation (TSXV: ASE | GSE: ASG | OTCQX: ASGOF) ("Asante" or the "Company") is pleased to announce strong results from its Reverse Circulation (RC) and Diamond Drilling programme at the Main Pit Bridge area at its Bibiani Gold Mine in Ghana. Extending the Main Pit through the Bibiani Bridge would enable portions of the northern Main Pit underground Mineral Resource to be accessed from surface, potentially bringing additional Mineral Resources into the LOM plan and deferring underground development capital expenditure currently planned for 2027-2028. Management plans to accelerate drilling, assaying, and mine planning in this area, which Management believes could represent a significant positive development for Bibiani's open-pittable material.

raw.title: Shareholders of Clean Air Metals and Fiore-Backed Springbok Ventures Overwhelmingly Approve Proposed Transaction
raw.text: Thunder Bay, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Clean Air Metals Inc. (TSXV: AIR) (FSE: CKU) (OTC Pink: CLRMF) ("Clean Air Metals") and Springbok Ventures Inc. ("Springbok"), a Fiore-backed unlisted reporting issuer, are pleased to announce that, further to their joint press releases of October 15, 2026, October 6, 2026, September 22, 2026, September 16, 2026, August 10, 2026 and July 31, 2026, at Clean Air Metals' annual general and special meeting held on November 13, 2026 (the "Clean Air Metals Meeting") and at Springbok's annual general and special meeting held on November 13, 2026 (the "Springbok Meeting"), the shareholders of each company overwhelmingly approved the proposed three-cornered amalgamation under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia), pursuant to which Springbok and 1602037 B.C. Ltd. ("Newco"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Clean Air Metals, will amalgamate and continue as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Clean Air Metals, and, immediately following the amalgamation, each Springbok shareholder, other than a dissenting shareholder, will receive 0.9 of a post-consolidation Clean Air Metals common share for each Springbok common share held (the "Transaction").

raw.title: Charlotte's Web Backs Bipartisan Plan for a Responsible Federal Hemp Framework That Protects Consumers and Preserves Access
raw.text: Company urges Congress to replace Section 781's sweeping hemp restrictions with sound, enforceable standards that protect children, eliminate synthetic and restricted intoxicating products such as delta-8 THC, and preserve access to therapeutic hemp products Louisville, Colorado--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Charlotte's Web Holdings, Inc. (TSX: CWEB) (OTCQX: CWBHF) today announced its strong support for the Hemp Guardrails Act, with bipartisan legislation introduced today by U.S. Senators Tim Sheehy (R-MT) and Amy Klobuchar (D-MN) that would replace the 0.4 milligram per-container limit in Section 781 of the Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026 and establish a federal regulatory framework that protects consumers while preserving access to responsibly manufactured hemp products. Section 781, set to take effect December 11, 2026, imposes a 0.4 milligram total-THC-per-container limit that fails to distinguish naturally occurring, non-intoxicating trace THC in full-spectrum hemp from synthetic and intoxicating THC products.

raw.title: Desert Mountain Energy Signs Binding Letter of Intent for Kansas Natural Gas and Helium Joint Venture
raw.text: Vancouver, Canada – TheNewswire - (November 16, 2026) — DESERT MOUNTAIN ENERGY CORP. (the “Company”) (“DME”) (TSX.V: DME, U.S. OTC: DMEHF, Frankfurt: QM01) has signed a binding letter of intent to form a joint venture with a private Kansas-based corporation for natural gas processing and helium extraction using DME's proprietary design and operating programs. The proposed joint venture contemplates initial expenditures of US$20 million, with no capital contribution required from DME. The initial development will include drilling seven wells to depths of approximately 6,000 feet and constructing a helium separation unit incorporating DME's proprietary design and automated features. Plans also include the recovery of waste gases for use in enhanced oil recovery (“EOR”).

raw.title: Golden Cariboo Advances Halo Zone Drilling as Step-Out Hole QGQ26-35 Exceeds 416 Metres
raw.text: November 18, 2026 – TheNewswire - Vancouver, B.C., Canada – Golden Cariboo Resources Ltd. (the “Company”) (CSE:GCC) (OTC:GCCFF) (WKN:A402CQ) (FSE:3TZ) announce an update of exploration activities at its 100%-owned Quesnelle Gold Quartz Mine Property located about 50 km southeast of Prince George, near Hixon in central British Columbia. Drilling continues on step-out hole QGQ26-35, which has now reached beyond 416 metres (1,365 feet) depth while remaining within the favourable volcanic package that hosts much of the Halo z one mineralization (see map enclos ure or visit Company website ) . Importantly, the hole has not yet intersected the projected western greenstone-argillite contact, extending the target horizon significantly beyond initial projections and supporting continued evaluation of the southern extension of the Halo Deposit beyond the limits of the Company's current Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE").   Since completion of the Company's inaugural Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE"), drilling, sampling and regional exploration activities have continued to advance. Geological logging has been completed on holes QGQ26-31 (seen in the below photo) through QGQ26-34, which were drilled after the MRE cut-off date and are therefore not included in the current resource model. Core samples from QGQ26-32 have been received by MSA Labs in Prince George for PhotonAssay™ analysis, samples from QGQ26-31 are expected to be submitted later this week, and QGQ26-33 core is anticipated to be at the lab next week. Core logging of QGQ26-34 and 35 is in progress. Assay results will be released when available.

raw.title: Investview, Inc. Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Strategic Business Update
raw.text: Haverford, PA, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Investview, Inc. (OTCQB: INVU) (the “Company”) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided an update on operating activity during the quarter. The quarter reflected a continued contraction in the Company's marketing network, a 10% increase in revenue from its health, beauty, and wellness businesses versus the second quarter of 2026, and continued investment in pre-commercial operations. Net income for the quarter was $9.0 million versus a $3.2 million loss in the second quarter of 2026, primarily attributable to the sale of the Company's equity investment in an early-stage nuclear power and infrastructure technology company. The sale generated $10.8 million in net cash proceeds, strengthening the Company's financial position while its operating businesses continued to face challenges. Management will continue to focus on simplifying the portfolio, strengthening capital-allocation discipline, and clarifying the roles of its operating businesses, including selective commercial integration among Conectiv, MyLife Wellness, and Renu Laboratories.

raw.title: Edgewater Wireless Announces Completion of Additional Payments of Debenture Interest
raw.text: November 19, 2026 – Ottawa, Canada – TheNewswire - Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. (TSXV: YFI) (OTC: KPIFF) (“ Edgewater ” or the “ Company ”) announces that it has settled its obligation to pay an aggregate of $17,726.30 in interest as of December 1, 2025, $17,531.51 in interest as of March 1, 2026, $17,921.10 in interest as of June 1, 2026 and $17,921.10 in interest as of September 1, 2026 to the holders of its unsecured debentures issued September 1, 2022 (the “ Debentures ”) through the issuance of an aggregate of 1,421,982 common shares of the Company at a deemed price of $0.05 per share (the “ Shares ”). The Shares are issued in full satisfaction of the December 1, 2025, March 1, 2026, June 1, 2026 and September 1, 2026 interest payment obligations in accordance with the terms of the Debentures, and represents the 13 th to 16 th interest payments pursuant to the terms of the Debentures. The debt settlement has been approved by the TSX Venture Exchange.   Certain directors of the Company received an aggregate of 265,995 Shares and therefore the share issuance constitutes a “related party transaction” as that term is defined in Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“ MI 61-101 ”). The Company will rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 as neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the debt exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization .

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 16, 2026) - LaFleur Minerals Inc. raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li-FT Power Ltd. (“LIFT” or the “Company”) (TSXV: LIFT) (ASX: LFT) (OTCQX: LIFFF) (Frankfurt: WS0) is pleased to report results from 11 drill holes completed at the Adina Lithium Project (“Adina” or the “Project”) in Québec, Canada (Figures 1, 2). raw.title: Metal Energy's First Drilling at NIV Confirms a Large Porphyry Copper-Gold System; Mineralization Strengthens to the North and Remains Open
raw.text: Highlights: A large porphyry copper-gold system confirmed: the first drilling ever at NIV returned hundreds of metres of continuous copper-gold-molybdenum mineralization from near surface, with the high-temperature alteration, multiple intrusive phases and vein stages characteristic of a major British Columbia porphyry system NIV26-011: 11.0 metres of 0.95% CuEq* (0.55 g/t Au, 0.21% Cu, 136 ppm Mo) within 39.35 metres of 0.41% CuEq from 55.65 metres, part of a continuously mineralized interval of 426.0 metres of 0.17% CuEq from 30.0 metres to the end of the hole, open at depth NIV26-004: 117.0 metres of 0.25% CuEq* (0.17 g/t Au, 0.04% Cu) from 144.0 metres, including 6.0 metres of 0.89% CuEq (0.76 g/t Au), within 326.5 metres of 0.17% CuEq from 5.9 metres The system vectors north: grade, gold content and high-temperature magnetite-potassium feldspar alteration all increase northward along the western side of the 5 kilometre trend; the northernmost and final hole of the season, NIV26-011, was the best hole, and the ground beyond it has never been drilled The 2026 holes tested the margins, not the core: the large airborne magnetic high at the heart of the northern target was only probed along its western flank, and the Company interprets the 2026 holes to have clipped the edges of a system whose strongest part remains untested Five of eleven holes reported; six to come: this release covers NIV26-001 to -004 and NIV26-011; assays for NIV26-005 to -010, including three of the four holes drilled along the margin of the magnetic high, are pending Clear plan for 2027: step-out drilling north of NIV26-011 and into the magnetic high, supported by detailed magnetics and IP over the northern part of the property Highland Valley drilling underway: drill program at Zones 1 and 2 began on November 7, 2026 Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 12, 2026) - Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV: MERG) (OTCQB: MEEEF) ("Metal Energy" or the "Company") is pleased to report the first assay results from its inaugural drill program at its 100%-controlled NIV copper-gold project (the "Project" or "NIV") in British Columbia's Toodoggone District. The 2026 program, the first drilling ever carried out at NIV, comprised 11 holes totalling 6,295 metres.

raw.title: NevGold Intercepts Strongest Result To Date in 2026: 8.28 g/t Oxide Au Over 3.0 Meters Within 1.73 g/t Oxide Au Over 45.7 Meters
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NevGold Corp. (“NevGold” or the “Company”) ( TSXV:NAU) (OTCQX:NAUFF) (Frankfurt:5E50) is pleased to announce additional oxide gold-antimony assays from the 2026 drill program at its Limousine Butte Project (the “Project”, “Limo Butte”) in Nevada. These results have continued to extend high-grade mineralization on the eastern side of the Resurrection Ridge resource, adding significant mineralization potential both inside and outside of the 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) pit-shell released on July 15, 2026 ( see News Release ). NevGold CEO, Brandon Bonifacio, comments: “The 2026 drill program at Limo Butte continues to deliver exceptional results, expanding mineralization beyond the boundaries of the current resource and supporting our objective of growing both the scale and quality of the 2026 MRE released in July. We are particularly encouraged by the consistency of high-grade oxide gold-antimony mineralization encountered on the eastern side of the Resurrection Ridge resource area. Hole LB26-009 was the strongest hole to date from our 2026 program intercepting grade up to 14.50 g/t oxide Au , with larger intervals of 8.28 g/t oxide Au over 3.0 meters within 1.73 g/t oxide Au over 45.7 meters . The program remains on schedule and under budget, with approximately 16,000 meters completed across 70 holes, and assays pending from 54 additional holes . The combination of exceptional results received, a substantial volume of assays still pending, and increasing confidence in our geological model reinforces our belief that Limo Butte is emerging as one of the most significant gold-antimony development projects in the United States. ”

raw.title: Northern Graphite Closes Sprott Streaming Financing Restructuring Transaction
raw.text: Transaction eliminates approximately US$23.6 million in senior secured debt and accrued interest Sprott Streaming becomes Northern's largest shareholder Ottawa, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 13, 2026) - Northern Graphite Corporation (TSXV: NGC) (OTCQB: NGPHF) (FSE: 0NG) (XSTU: 0NG) (the "Company" or "Northern ") is pleased to announce that it has closed its previously announced agreement to restructure its secured debt, stream and royalty financing arrangements with funds managed by Sprott Resource Streaming and Royalty Corp. (collectively, "Sprott Streaming"), strengthening the Company's financial position. Under the terms of the agreement, all amounts owed to Sprott Streaming under its senior secured loan to the Company, consisting of approximately US$16.0 million in principal amount and approximately US$7.6 million in accrued interest, have been fully satisfied through the issuance of 12.5 million common shares of the Company to Sprott Streaming, resulting in Sprott Streaming increasing its interest in the Company to 9.9% of its basic shares outstanding and becoming the Company's largest shareholder, and through amendments to the streaming agreement relating to Northern's Okanjande project in Namibia.

raw.text: November 17 , 2026 – TheNewswire - Rockport, Ontario – New Age Metals Inc. (“ NAM ” or the “ Company ”) (TSXV: NAM; OTCQB: NMTLF; FSE: P7J) is pleased to announce that, further to its news release of October 27, 2026 , the Company has completed its due diligence and has provided a notice to proceed to arm's length party Benton Resources Inc. raw.title: Paladin Successfully Completes A$525 Million Fully Underwritten Equity Raising
raw.text: Not for release to US newswire services or distribution in the United States  PERTH, Australia, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Paladin Energy Ltd (ASX:PDN, TSX:PDN) (Paladin or the Company) announces the successful completion of its fully underwritten A$525 million equity raising, comprising (i) an A$499 million ASX institutional placement of new Paladin fully paid ordinary shares (Shares) (ASX Placement), and (ii) a Canadian “bought deal” private placement to raise C$25 million (~A$26 million) pursuant to the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption (as defined herein) (TSX Bought Deal) (together, the Offer).1 As announced on 12 November 2026, Paladin also intends to invite Eligible Shareholders (as defined herein) to participate in a non-underwritten Share Purchase Plan to acquire Shares at the same price as the ASX Placement to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs) (SPP). Highlights Successful bookbuild for a fully underwritten equity raising to raise A$525 million (before costs), comprising: A fully underwritten ASX Placement of approximately 64.0 million new Shares priced at A$7.80 per Share to raise ~A$499 million (before costs); and A fully underwritten TSX Bought Deal of approximately 3.3 million new Shares priced at C$7.62 per Share to raise ~A$26 million (C$25 million) (before costs) The Offer received strong demand from new and existing investors, which resulted in an increase in the ASX Placement component of the Offer Opportunity for Eligible Shareholders with registered addresses in Australia or New Zealand to participate via a non-underwritten SPP to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs) The equity raising positions Paladin for its next phase of growth, funding the ongoing development of the Patterson Lake South Project (PLS Project), potential resource growth and mine life extension at Triple R, and advancing exploration opportunities across the broader Athabasca Basin region portfolio.

raw.title: Paladin Successfully Completes A$525 Million Fully Underwritten Equity Raising
raw.text: Not for release to US newswire services or distribution in the United States  PERTH, Australia, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Paladin Energy Ltd (ASX:PDN, TSX:PDN) (Paladin or the Company) announces the successful completion of its fully underwritten A$525 million equity raising, comprising (i) an A$499 million ASX institutional placement of new Paladin fully paid ordinary shares (Shares) (ASX Placement), and (ii) a Canadian “bought deal” private placement to raise C$25 million (~A$26 million) pursuant to the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption (as defined herein) (TSX Bought Deal) (together, the Offer).1 As announced on 12 November 2026, Paladin also intends to invite Eligible Shareholders (as defined herein) to participate in a non-underwritten Share Purchase Plan to acquire Shares at the same price as the ASX Placement to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs) (SPP). Highlights Successful bookbuild for a fully underwritten equity raising to raise A$525 million (before costs), comprising: A fully underwritten ASX Placement of approximately 64.0 million new Shares priced at A$7.80 per Share to raise ~A$499 million (before costs); and A fully underwritten TSX Bought Deal of approximately 3.3 million new Shares priced at C$7.62 per Share to raise ~A$26 million (C$25 million) (before costs) The Offer received strong demand from new and existing investors, which resulted in an increase in the ASX Placement component of the Offer Opportunity for Eligible Shareholders with registered addresses in Australia or New Zealand to participate via a non-underwritten SPP to raise up to a further A$50 million (before costs) The equity raising positions Paladin for its next phase of growth, funding the ongoing development of the Patterson Lake South Project (PLS Project), potential resource growth and mine life extension at Triple R, and advancing exploration opportunities across the broader Athabasca Basin region portfolio.

raw.text: Company gains access to more than 53 million U.S. buyers on a platform where beauty is the top category and products listing peptides as an ingredient command the highest average price of any top 10 beauty ingredient Highlights Approved TikTok Shop storefront: The Company has been approved to operate its own TikTok Shop in the United States, giving it a direct sales channel to more than 53 million U.S. buyers. raw.title: Pinnacle Closes First Tranche of Private Placement
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - November 19, 2026 - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. The Offering will consist of up to a total of 10,000,000 units (the "Units") with each Unit, priced at $0.11, comprising one common share (“Share”) in the capital of the Company and one-half share purchase warrant ("Warrant").  Each whole Warrant shall be convertible into an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.16 for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.  The Company is seeking to raise gross proceeds of up to $1,100,000, of which $420,985.00 has already been raised in tranche one.

raw.title: Puma Refines the Grog Gold Zone Potential
raw.text: Rimouski, Quebec--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Puma Exploration Inc. raw.title: Renforth Completes Updated Mineral Resource Estimate On Wholly Owned Parbec Gold Deposit In Malartic, Quebec
raw.text: TORONTO, Ontario — November 18, 2026 – TheNewswire —  Renforth Resources Inc. (CSE: RFR | OTC: RFHRF | FSE: 9RR) ("Renforth" or the "Company") is pleased to advise shareholders that P&E Mining Consultants Inc. (“P&E”) have completed an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) on the Company's wholly owned Parbec Gold Deposit in Malartic, Quebec, located on the Cadillac Break and contiguous to Agnico Eagle's Canadian Malartic Mine Property.  The updated MRE, stated below, is comprised of a pit constrained, Indicated Mineral Resource of 168,700 ounces of gold grading 1.10 g/t contained within 4.77 million tonnes and an additional pit constrained Inferred Mineral Resource of 192,900 ounces of gold grading 1.22 g/t Au contained within 4.91 million tonnes. There is also an out of pit (underground) Inferred Mineral Resource of 74,200 ounces of gold, grading 1.79 g/t Au contained within 1.29 million tonnes. The total Mineral Resource presented by P&E, effective November 17, 2026, is 168,700 Indicated ounces of gold and 267,000 Inferred ounces of gold with the assumptions and considerations stated below. This represents an overall increase to the prior April 2025 MRE for Parbec, however, it does not trigger the requirement to file another Technical Report. As previously announced on Nov. 12, 2026, Renforth has retained P&E to commence overseeing metallurgical testwork on Parbec mineralization which is designed to support a Preliminary Economic Assessment in 2027.   “I am pleased to deliver this Mineral Resource increase, for our Parbec Gold Deposit to shareholders at this time, however, at the same time I want to emphasize that our work at Parbec is ongoing. We are awaiting results from the additional channels cut within the open pit footprint announced last week and will be working to establish the metallurgical characteristics of the Deposit. Additionally, we are permitted for a significant amount of drilling in the next two years. Today's announcement makes our Mineral Resource current, in terms of gold price and the inclusion of all our completed exploration work. We will continue to move forward from here” states Nicole Brewster, President and CEO of Renforth.

raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Riverside Resources Inc. ("Riverside" or the "Company") (TSX-V: RRI) (OTCQB: RVSDF) (FSE: 5YY0) is pleased to announce that drilling has started on its Phase 2B Reverse Circulation (“RC”) drill program at the La Union Project in Sonora, Mexico, as outlined in the Company's news release dated November 9, 2026. The drill rig has been mobilized and is now drilling at the Luis Hill target. At Luis Hill, this program will follow up on the sediment-hosted gold mineralization intersected in Phase 1 drilling. Step-out drilling will go deeper than previous holes to test the newly identified induced polarization (IP) geophysical target and the extent of the shale beds encountered during core drilling.
